title: Stop a Context value from re-rendering every consumer
prompt: A Context provider hands down a fresh value object on every render, so all consumers re-render on unrelated updates — even a memo()'d one. Give the value a stable identity so consumers re-render only when their data actually changes.
acceptanceCriteria: The context consumer renders once on initial mount (render count shows 1)
Clicking the unrelated "Tick" button does NOT re-render the memo'd consumer (render count stays 1)
Toggling the theme still updates the consumer (theme text changes light -> dark)
